title: Universal NAND Gate Synthesis
summary: NAND is a Universal Gate because any Boolean function (NOT, AND, OR, XOR, Adders, MUXes) can be constructed exclusively using NAND gates without any other component.

images.title: NAND Synthesized Gates
images.caption: Schematic diagrams for NOT, AND, OR, and XOR built from 7400 NAND gates.

working_principle: 1) NOT: Tie inputs A=B together -> (A·A)' = A'. 2) AND: NAND followed by Inverter -> ((A·B)')' = A·B. 3) OR: Invert A and B, then NAND -> (A'·B')' = A+B (DeMorgan). 4) XOR: 4 NAND gates.
applications: Single-IC Type Printed Circuit Board Manufacturing (Cost reduction)
ASIC Standard Cell Libraries based on NAND cells
Universal Gate Transformations in Digital Electronics Exams
advantages: Standardizes IC inventory to only IC 7400
disadvantages: Increases total gate count and propagation delay for complex circuits
common_mistakes: Wiring DeMorgan OR synthesis with incorrect inverter connections.

viva_questions.q: How many NAND gates are required to construct an OR gate?
How many NAND gates form a 1-bit Half Adder?

interview_questions.q: Prove that (A' · B')' is equal to A + B.
interview_questions.a: By DeMorgan's Law, (X · Y)' = X' + Y'. Substitute X = A' and Y = B': ((A')' + (B')') = A + B.
